summary.en: Winter temperatures often drop between -20°C and -35°C (-4°F to -31°F). Frostbite can occur on exposed skin within minutes.
summary.zh: 冬季气温经常降至 -20°C 到 -35°C (-4°F 到 -31°F)。裸露的皮肤在几分钟内就可能发生冻伤。

mitigations.en: Dress in 3-4 layers: thermal base, wool/fleece mid, down jacket, windproof shell.
mitigations.zh: 穿着 3-4 层衣物：保暖内衣、羊毛/抓绒中层、羽绒服、防风外层。

mitigations.en: Cover face with a scarf or balaclava; wear two pairs of socks (thin liner + thick wool).
mitigations.zh: 用围巾或巴拉克拉瓦帽遮住面部；穿两双袜子（薄内衬袜 + 厚羊毛袜）。

mitigations.en: Keep electronic devices (phones/cameras) close to your body heat to prevent battery death.
mitigations.zh: 将电子设备（手机/相机）贴近身体保暖，以防电池耗尽。

summary.en: Reindeer roam freely and often stand on roads. They are camouflaged in the dark and do not fear cars.
summary.zh: 驯鹿自由漫游，经常站在道路上。它们在黑暗中很难被发现（有伪装色），且不害怕汽车。

mitigations.en: Drive cautiously, especially at dawn, dusk, and night.
mitigations.zh: 驾驶时要小心，尤其是在黎明、黄昏和夜间。

mitigations.en: If you see one reindeer, assume there are more nearby.
mitigations.zh: 如果你看到一只驯鹿，请假设附近还有更多。

summary.en: Sidewalks and town streets are often covered in packed ice and can be extremely slippery.
summary.zh: 人行道和城镇街道经常覆盖着压实的冰，可能非常滑。

mitigations.en: Wear boots with non-slip soles or use detachable anti-slip grips/spikes.
mitigations.zh: 穿防滑底的靴子或使用可拆卸的防滑冰爪。

mitigations.en: Walk like a penguin: lean forward slightly and keep weight on your front leg.
mitigations.zh: 像企鹅一样走路：身体微前倾，重心放在前腿上。

items.zh: 保暖打底衣（推荐美利奴羊毛）

items.en: Heavy insulated winter boots (rated for -20°C or lower)
items.zh: 厚保暖冬季靴（额定温度 -20°C 或更低）

items.en: Touchscreen gloves + heavy mittens (mittens keep fingers warmer together)
items.zh: 触屏手套 + 厚连指手套（连指手套让手指在一起更暖和）

items.en: Reflectors (safety reflectors for walking in the dark - mandatory by law)
items.zh: 反光挂件（在黑暗中行走的安全反光板 - 法律强制要求）

items.en: Portable power bank (cold drains batteries fast)
items.zh: 便携式充电宝（寒冷会加速电池消耗）

items.en: Moisturizer and lip balm (air is very dry)
items.zh: 保湿霜和润唇膏（空气非常干燥）

items.en: Book husky/reindeer safaris months in advance for December visits
items.zh: 如果是 12 月访问，请提前数月预订哈士奇/驯鹿雪橇活动

items.en: Dinner reservations (restaurants in Rovaniemi center get full in peak season)
items.zh: 晚餐预订（旺季时罗瓦涅米市中心的餐厅会客满）

items.en: Download 'Menevä' or 'Valopilkku' taxi apps (Uber availability varies)
items.zh: 下载 'Menevä' 或 'Valopilkku' 出租车应用（Uber 可用性不稳定）

message.en: In Finland, the Road Traffic Act requires pedestrians to use a reflector when moving on the road during dark hours, even in built-up areas. This applies to tourists too.
message.zh: 在芬兰，道路交通法要求行人在黑暗时段在道路上行走时必须使用反光挂件，即使在市区也是如此。这也适用于游客。

title.en: Buy or pack a hanging safety reflector
title.zh: 购买或打包一个悬挂式安全反光件

message.en: December is peak season. Activities (Husky, Reindeer, Snowmobile) and Glass Igloos often sell out 3-6 months in advance. Taxis can have long wait times.
message.zh: 12 月是旺季。活动（哈士奇、驯鹿、雪地摩托）和玻璃冰屋通常提前 3-6 个月售罄。出租车可能需要等待很长时间。

message.en: The Northern Lights are natural and never guaranteed. You need clear skies and solar activity. Rovaniemi creates light pollution; for better chances, move away from the city center (e.g., Ounasvaara or Arctic Garden).
message.zh: 北极光是自然现象，绝无保证。你需要晴朗的天空和太阳活动。罗瓦涅米有光污染；为了增加机会，请远离市中心（例如前往 Ounasvaara 或 Arctic Garden）。

title.zh: 下载 'Aurora' 或 'My Aurora Forecast' 应用
